Name: AutoScythe
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod detects ripe crops, forage items, and more, then harvests them with a scythe.
[*]It includes customizable automation settings via GMCM to adjust the level of automation.
[*]No need to manually switch tools—saving you time and effort.
[*]The scythe will grant related skill experience when harvesting forage items, and the quality and drop quantity will also be influenced by the forage skill.This fully adheres to the original game’s skill design.
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b][list=1]
[*]Equip your scythe.
[*]Approach anything that can be harvested.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]You can set harvest targets like crops, forage items, fruit trees, moss, bush fruits, weeds.
[*]You can also ignore flowers to prevent interfering with bee house production.
[/list]
